Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
About the project: 
 We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer with strong software engineering and OOP skills who uses AI throughout the development process. You will work with AI frameworks such as BMAD and SpecKit and help improve them for the bank’s needs.
 Discover Raiffeisen Tech: 
 Raiffeisen Tech Romania, a subsidiary of Raiffeisen Tech GmbH in Vienna, brings together experienced tech talents to enable Raiffeisen Bank International (RBI) Group to offer innovative technology solutions. The company fosters a collaborative environment for building international projects using advanced technologies, embracing a flexible approach and valuing curiosity and courage to innovate.
 Your mission: 
 • Design, develop, test and document software components across the full stack (backend, APIs, data layer, frontend)
 • Apply AI-driven SDLC practices end to end: spec-driven development, AI-assisted requirements, design, coding, testing, code review and documentation
 • Contribute to and evolve our internal AI-SDLC frameworks, prompts, agents and guidelines
 • Shape solution architecture together with architects and the team, with a focus on modern, cloud-ready design
 • Conduct code reviews and security assessments, including review of AI-generated code
 • Bring a DevOps mindset to the whole lifecycle: coding standards, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, infrastructure as code and security best practices
 Required superpowers: 
 • Proven hands-on experience with the AI-driven software development lifecycle, ideally with frameworks such as BMAD, SpecKit or similar spec-driven approaches
 • Practical experience with GenAI tools and coding agents in development (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot), including prompt and context engineering, and a critical eye for the quality and security of AI-generated output
 • Hands-on backend development in Java
 • Solid understanding of modern architecture: layered and distributed design, microservices, event-driven approaches, and clean separation of data, application, API and frontend layers
 • Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS)
 • Solid command of API technologies and API design and security
 • Frontend experience with a modern framework (e.g. Angular, React or Blazor)
 Nice to have: 
 • Experience in banking or another regulated environment
 • Experience building AI-enabled features (LLM integration, RAG, agents)
 • Experience introducing or coaching others on AI-assisted ways of working
